title: Trimethyltin chloride triggers ferroptosis in myocardial injury: mitochondria-dependent protection by luteolin.

outcomes.name: myocardial ferroptosis
outcomes.effect_text: Lut alleviated TMT-induced myocardial injury by activating mitophagy, inhibiting ferroptosis, then restoring mitochondrial function

outcomes.name: mitochondrial fusion and mitophagy protein expression
outcomes.effect_text: TMT increased DRP1 phosphorylation and reduced the expression of mitochondrial fusion and mitophagy proteins, which were restored by Lut
